title: DSTP001
content:
[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Job Role – Project Coordinator"]Qualifications – Master’s degree in social work or equivalent, M.Sc., B.E. Graduates, Experience – 3-4 years of experience in social sector/ Education / Livelihood, Location – Mysore No. of Vacancies – 01 Salary – 30,000/- (Consolidated)   Role and Responsibilities Project Coordinator will be recruited to handle the requirements of this facility and including understand the variety of requirements relating to the necessities of the training programs.
  • Focus on interaction with the beneficiaries.
  • Design and development of curriculum for the skill development programs and conducting training programs
  • Development of App for the HUB and audio / video materials for the training program in vernacular language and awareness campaign programs about the facility in the village.
  • Procurement of non-recurring items as per the proposal submitted for STI Hub establishment.
  • Organize trainer and resources also develop and manage project documents
  • Update the meetings with implementation of training program and disseminate meeting minutes.
  • Preparing the Publications and application for patent
  • All the above-mentioned duties should be communicated and get approval form the Principal Investigator
  • Duties assigned by the PI and Co-PI to be completed as per the timeline and should be available in the campus on duty hours
Basic Qualifications & Competencies
  • Master’s degree in Social work or equivalent, M.Sc., B.E. Graduates
  • Basic knowledge in engineering is preferable
  • 3-4 years of experience in Social sector/ Education / Livelihood
  • Knowledge in M.S Office, Data Analysis on Excel (Basic), Report writing and Documentation, Team Management and Networking, Presentation skills, Communication skills (written and verbal in English, Kannada & Hindi),
  • Ability to work independently & collaboratively with internal & external Stakeholders
  • Excellent written & verbal skills (in Kannada, English is desirable and in Hindi is preferable)
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
